indicators.context: Default User-Agent of every Apex session (config defaultHeaders and the session fallback). Sent by the http_request tool and added with -H to curl, wget, nuclei, ffuf, gobuster, httpx, feroxbuster, dirb, wfuzz, wpscan, sqlmap and nikto commands for in-scope hosts. The operator can change it with pensar config headers
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Pensar Apex source code
